experiment.purpose: Lock a common song/audio truth before later OSS director/generation optimization is introduced, so baseline and optimized paths remain comparable.

selection_priorities: useful difficulty for OSS optimization comparison

formal_candidates.why_now: Fresh stage-driven spread is still accelerating. Li Jiawei is actively pushing a 15-second/70-character challenge, Wang Zhengliang has a recent cut, and independent music-analysis/instrument accounts are following within the same short window.
formal_candidates.why_for_this_test: Dense lyrics, emotional progression and rhythm pressure make this a useful stress test for director planning and dynamic-generation optimization; improvement should be easier to distinguish from merely choosing an easy scenic song.
formal_candidates.risk: High lyric density can tempt over-cutting and literal illustration; exact Douyin audio version must be locked at HG02.
